title_local.description: Short title in the output language

one_liner.description: One-sentence conclusion: what was done plus the key number

profile_brief.description: One sentence for the reader's project: which part, what to do

problem.description: The problem, and why existing approaches fall short

method.description: How it works - the mechanism, not a restated abstract (3-5 sentences)

results.description: Key results: benchmarks, baselines, concrete numbers

limitations.description: Weaknesses: experiment scale, fairness of comparisons, reliance on frontier models, reproducibility

code.description: Whether code/models/data are released, with links; 'not mentioned' if absent

modules.description: Affected parts of the reader's project, using the names from the context

insight.description: Concrete implications: how to use it, what to change, or why it does not apply
